source_name: Bolagsverket — Värdefulla datamängder (Valuable Datasets) API v1
organization: Bolagsverket (Swedish Companies Registration Office), with SCB data behind the same gateway
auth: OAuth2 client_credentials, scope vardefulla-datamangder:read (WSO2 API Manager gateway)
license: Free of charge, no contract — EU Open Data Directive high-value datasets (2019/1024); confirm exact reuse terms per dataset
endpoints: POST /organisationer (company base data by organisationsnummer -> JSON)
POST /dokumentlista (list annual-report documents for an org)
GET /dokument/{id} (download document -> ZIP containing iXBRL annual report)
financial_data: Annual reports (årsredovisning) as iXBRL tagged to Swedish K2/K3 taxonomies (taxonomier.se): income statement + balance sheet
notes: PRIMARY source. Launched 26 June 2025 under EU high-value-datasets rule. Free OAuth credentials issued via self-service Kundanmälan (email+phone -> client_id/client_secret, test+prod). Endpoints verified live: /isalive and /organisationer return HTTP 401 'Missing Credentials' (WSO2), confirming they exist behind OAuth. Annual reports = financial data.

api_base_url: SCB business-register web service (REST JSON/XML over HTTPS; endpoint provided with certificate)
auth: Client certificate today (request via scbforetag@scb.se); API-key model announced from September 2026
rate_limits: max 2,000 rows per request; 10 requests per 10 seconds per user
data_freshness: nightly Mon-Fri import; most variables weekly, some annual; sourced from Skatteverket
notes: SECONDARY/seed source. Fee-free since 26 June 2025, CC0. Best for full company+workplace universe, CFAR ids, SNI, employee size-class. No financials. Certificate auth migrating to API key Sept 2026.

license: catalog metadata; points to source licenses
fields_observed: dataset metadata only — points to Bolagsverket VDM and SCB services
notes: National DCAT catalog confirming publishers and free status. Page is a JS SPA; data served from gw.api.bolagsverket.se and SCB.

source_name: Bolagsverket — paid XML bulk packet / legacy company API
fields_observed: full register fields via XML packet
data_freshness: monthly bulk (first weekday of month); API real-time
notes: Historical paid products: XML bulk packet (forsaljning@bolagsverket.se) and legacy API (~SEK 6,250 onboarding + usage). Superseded for open use by the free Värdefulla datamängder API. Listed for completeness.
UBO register exists but is not part of the free open-API set. Out of scope for open ingestion.

source_name: Commercial aggregators (allabolag.se, bolagsapi.se, apiverket.se, foretagsapi.se, OpenCorporates, Apify)
notes: Fallback/comparison only. Mostly repackage the same official Bolagsverket/SCB data behind their own keys with normalized JSON. Not primary official sources.
